credits_text: Written and directed by Ataka51. Cinematography by Sergei Medvedev. Music composed and performed by Leonid Fedorov, Vladimir Martynov with Tatiana Grindenko and "Opus Posth". Sound engineer: Andrei Levin. Sound design: Stanislav Paushev, Arten Slesarev. Sound editing: Ataka51. Grading: Nick Vavilov.
other_text: Costume designer Nadezhda Vasilieva. Production design Anastasia Bezrukova. Casting by Avdotja Alexandrova. Visual effects by Andrei Bulatchick and Ataka51 with the help of Andrei Zvyagin, Rustam Gobeikov, Sergei Nikulin and Pavel Gordeev. Producer Dmitry Bocharov. Post-production producer Olga Zorina. Executive producer Pavel Karykhalin. Produced by Stereotactic. Special thanks to Sergey Seilanov.
description: A dark, moody poster features a broken piano with scattered debris, overlaid with credits for the film "Hymn of the Plague".
